findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lokha_get_agent_inbox, lokha_get_dispatches, zernio_list_accounts, zernio_get_queue, zernio_manage_post, zernio_get_analytics, zernio_api_call, buffer_list_channels, gumroad_list_products · Private data: lokha_register_or_login, lokha_moltbook_login, lokha_connect_social_provider, lokha_agent_wallet, tara_wallet_action, lokha_memory_add · Public sink: lokha_send_dispatch, lokha_submit_draft, lokha_submit_article_draft, zernio_publish_post, zernio_manage_post, zernio_api_call, buffer_create_post, lokha_broadcast_to_socials, lokha_claim_bounty · Destructive: zernio_manage_post, zernio_api_call, buffer_graphql_query, social_multistep_orchestrator, lokha_governance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lokha_get_agent_inbox, lokha_get_dispatches, zernio_list_accounts, zernio_get_queue, zernio_manage_post, zernio_get_analytics, zernio_api_call, buffer_list_channels, gumroad_list_products · Private data: lokha_register_or_login, lokha_moltbook_login, lokha_connect_social_provider, lokha_agent_wallet, tara_wallet_action, lokha_memory_add · Public sink: lokha_send_dispatch, lokha_submit_draft, lokha_submit_article_draft, zernio_publish_post, zernio_manage_post, zernio_api_call, buffer_create_post, lokha_broadcast_to_socials, lokha_claim_bounty · Destructive: zernio_manage_post, zernio_api_call, buffer_graphql_query, social_multistep_orchestrator, lokha_governance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
